I added a 0.25 s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, so the loop sends at most 4 requests per second. That's under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. The interval is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file, with a comment explaining the limit.

I haven't run the test. It calls the live sandbox, so I can't confirm the flake is gone. If it still fails in CI, other tests that hit the sandbox at the same time could be pushing the total over the limit.

I didn't save anything to EngramDB. The rate limit is the only durable fact from this task, and the comment in the file records it.
